requirements.text: Degree in computational biology, bioinformatics, statistics, quantitative biological science, or a related field, or equivalent research experience.
Demonstrated experience analyzing biological assay data and translating scientific requirements into practical analytical workplans.
Strong statistical judgment in assessing reproducibility, experimental controls, batch effects, and measurement uncertainty.
Proficiency in Python or R, with experience building reproducible analyses, maintaining code in Git, and documenting methods.
Experience assessing data quality, missingness, preprocessing assumptions, and the suitability of datasets for downstream analysis.
Working knowledge of machine learning validation, including held-out evaluation, confounding, and risks of information leakage.
Ability to explain uncertainty and analytical tradeoffs clearly and collaborate effectively with bioinformaticians, chemists, and biologists.
Ability to independently execute defined work, meet agreed milestones, incorporate feedback, and handle internal data securely.
Advanced degree in computational biology, bioinformatics, statistics, or a related field.
Experience with quantitative proteomics, AP-MS, or other high-dimensional biological profiling assays.
Experience comparing profile similarity, control-relative scoring, batch correction, or reference-panel validation methods.
Experience with drug discovery, DEL analysis, scientific evidence evaluation, or collaboration between bioinformatics and ML teams.
Experience with Databricks, cloud/HPC workflows, or computational projects in biotechnology.
